entities.name: Jaroslav Papoušek
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jaroslav Papoušek was a Czech film director and screenwriter. He started as a sculptor, before writing screenplays with Miloš Forman and Ivan Passer. In 1968 he started directing his own screenplays.
